The massive main event Amazon Black Friday sale is now flying with some of the best AirPods deals ever. Delivering what is quite possibly the very best deal we have tracked all year for anything, you can now score the world’s best earbuds at a wildly low price – AirPods Pro 3 are now $100 off. On top of that, the truly next-generation 2026 AirPods Max 2 have now dropped to one of the lowest prices ever for Black Friday at $130 off.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $149 (Reg. $249) – $100 off!
  • AirPods Max 2 $419 (Reg. $549) – Now even lower at $130 off

AirPods Pro 3 Black Friday deal

Regularly $249, Amazon is now delivering AirPods Pro 3 down at a wild $149 shipped right now – the lowest price we have ever tracked and one of the best deals on anything, anywhere, ever.

While Apple certainly did unleash its new entry AirPods 5 back in September, that’s not going to matter much to just about anyone right now, considering you can score the far more powerful and feature-rich AirPods Pro 3 at the same price as AirPods 5 with Wireless Charging Case – they are still sitting at full price right now.

Some folks might prefer the open-ear vibe on the entry sets, but AirPods Pro 3 deliver 3x better noise cancellation, longer battery life, built-in heart rate sensing, and a host of specialty features like Hearing Test, Hearing Aid, and Hearing Protection features.

If you’re even mildly considering a new pair of AirPods Pro 3, for yourself or otherwise, the Black Friday deal live right now is a total no-brainer.

AirPods Max 2

Apple finally unleashed a proper next-generation set of over-ears this year, and you can land a set at a solid $130 off the list price right now. Regularly $549, all five colors of the latest AirPods Max 2 are now sitting down at the $419 Black Friday price to deliver the best deal of the season.

Only once have we seen them sell for a touch lower than this, and that was nearly 6 months ago and quite hard to come by – the listing constantly went out of stock, making it difficult to nab the color you wanted.
